summary: Baidu filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) attaching a Hong Kong Exchange Next Day Disclosure Return dated September 30, 2026, covering on-market share repurchases. Between September 7 and September 30, 2026, the company bought back roughly 10.0 million Class A ordinary shares (each day ~0.025-0.027% of issued shares) at prices ranging from HKD 84.75 to HKD 92.38 per share. All repurchased shares are held for cancellation but not yet cancelled; issued shares stayed at 2,209,541,178. Watch the pace of buybacks and eventual cancellation, which slowly accretes per-share value.
